name: StablR USD
oneLiner: USDR is StablR's MiCA-licensed dollar e-money token redeemable 1:1, backed by cash and short-term EU government bonds under Malta MFSA EMI supervision.
collateral: Cash and short-term government bonds held with regulated European financial institutions

genius.notes: StablR publishes reserve visibility and quarterly independent reviews, not a monthly public attestation cadence. The May 24 2026 multisig exploit caused a MiCA backing breach and MFSA settlement penalty (Ref: 2026-19, June 2 2026) — a MiCA/DORA matter with no U.S. GENIUS Act implications. No PPSI approval, state-qualified status, official application, or foreign exception found.

mintAuthority.summary: USDR is a MiCA e-money token issued by StablR Ltd (Malta MFSA-supervised EMI); tokens are minted and redeemed 1:1 through StablR's regulated issuance API, with live Ethereum owner and proxy-admin authority resolving to multisig-style contracts.

mintIncident.summary: A compromised StablR mint/governance key let the attacker mint 8.35M unbacked USDR as part of a coordinated USDR/EURR attack, leaving both tokens undercollateralized and forcing mint/redeem suspension.

controls.label: USDR token owner

controls.label: USDR EIP-1967 proxy admin
controls.evidence: EIP-1967 proxy-admin slot returned this address; multisig method reads returned 1 required signature and 1 owner.

review.evidence: USDR is a MiCAR-compliant EMT issued by StablR Ltd under MFSA EMI supervision, redeemable 1:1 via StablR's API; live Ethereum reads resolve the token owner to a 2/2 multisig-style contract and the proxy admin to a 1/1 multisig-style contract.
